tools.name: get_tasks
tools.description: Returns the full list of tasks with their IDs, text, and completion status. Use this to inspect current state before making changes.

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Creates a new task with the given text. The task starts as active (not completed). Returns the created task.

text.description: The text description of the task to create.

tools.name: update_task_status
tools.description: Marks a specific task as complete or pending by its ID. Use get_tasks first to find the correct ID.

id.description: The unique ID of the task to update.

completed.description: Set to true to mark the task as completed, or false to mark it as pending/active.

tools.name: edit_task_text
tools.description: Modifies the text content of an existing task by its ID. Use get_tasks first to find the correct ID.

id.description: The unique ID of the task to edit.

new_text.description: The new text content for the task.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently removes a task by its ID. This cannot be undone. Use get_tasks first to find the correct ID.

id.description: The unique ID of the task to delete.

tools.name: clear_completed_tasks
tools.description: Removes all tasks that are currently marked as completed. Returns the list of removed tasks.

tools.name: set_ui_filter
tools.description: Changes the current view filter to show "all", "active", or "completed" tasks.

filter.description: The filter to apply: "all" shows every task, "active" shows only pending tasks, "completed" shows only finished tasks.
